name: Secret Drop
short_desc: One-time encrypted links for handing an API key or password to an AI agent without chat.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Write-only, one-time credential handoff from a human to any agent (Hermes or others). The agent asks for a key and sends you a link; you type the value there; your browser encrypts it to that agent's own public key; the agent picks it up once and decrypts it locally. This app only relays ciphertext and keeps nothing long-term. It is not a password manager.

form_fields.label: Link address shown to people (optional)
form_fields.hint: Leave empty to use whatever address the agent used. Set it if agents reach this app by an internal name, so links still open on your phone or laptop.

form_fields.label: Agent API token (optional)
form_fields.hint: Leave empty on a Tailscale-only server. If set (32+ characters), agents must send it as a bearer token to create and pick up requests. The human link never needs it.
